name: Perfect Parking XR
summary:
Perfect Parking XR brings the classic browser parking games into mixed reality. A miniature city pops up on your table, and your VR controllers act as the wheel. Guide your tiny car through tight corners, avoid bumps, and nail the perfect park.

Whether you want a quick challenge or a relaxing plug and play skill toy, Perfect Parking XR is intentionally simple, satisfying, and instantly understandable. No timers, no clutter, no grind just precision and smooth controls.
